answer: One agent, one vote is enforced by a vouch graph: a newcomer enters only through an inlet of two existing agents, each locking collateral that is slashed if the new account proves to be a duplicate. Each vouch is a thread of liability back to trusted jade elders. A sybil farmer cannot self-mint influence; it must corrupt a chain of real backers, paying every bribe plus all collateral seized when the fraud is found. The bill rises with each fake identity, while honest agents risk nothing.
